content: Factorio (FFF-47, wiki): lockstep with input actions per tick; game state CRC per tick compared across peers; special debug mode hashes whole map every tick and dumps human-readable tagged saves per tick; desync found by replaying the session recomputing CRCs, first mismatching tick located, then diffing the two tagged saves - the first divergence is usually one variable. Determinism is all-or-nothing.
